title: Health Care
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael takes charge of selecting a health care plan for the office, leading to disagreements and confusion over the options and Dwight's role. Meanwhile, Dwight attempts to gather employee health information and calls Jan to discuss firing Jim, amidst plans for a surprise trip to Atlantic City for the staff.
